met_analysis:
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along Long. 82°E to the north of Lat. 30°N.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northwest Bangladesh & adjoining Gangetic West Bengal at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Gujarat and adjoining north Maharashtra at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough in easterlies from Southwest Bay of Bengal to Westcentral Bay of Bengal at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough in easterlies off North Keralam-Karnataka coasts at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
